source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of understanding your market (PDF 216).

blocks.text: Marketing se pehle market samjhein: mumkina gahak, un ki zarooratein aur aap ka product unhein kaise poora karta hai pehchanein. Riwayati Pakistani libas ke liye target market mein Eid ya shadiyon ki tayyari karne wale log hain, jinhein riwayati libas chahiye.

blocks.prompt: August mein school bags ki target market kaun hai?
blocks.explanation: Naye taleemi saal ki tayyari karne wale walidain aur students.

items: Market jaanein: gahak, zarooratein aur aap kaise poora karte hain (Eid aur shadi ke libas).
